senses.gloss:
पूर्व- + अपर पूर्व- + अपर,
 I. adj. 1. being before and behind. 2. prior and subsequent.
 II. n. sing. 1. east and west. 2. connexion, Man. 8, 56 (Proof, and thing to be proved, Ragh.).
पुरुष- + अर्थ पुरुष- + अर्थ, m. 1. the object or aim of man. 2. human exertion.
पुरीष- + आधान पुरीष- + आधान, n. the strait-gut.
पुरीषाधान पुरीष-आ:धान, n. The strait-gut, Yājñ. 3, 94.
पूर्व- + आशिन् पूर्व- + आशिन्, adj., eating before (others), MBh. 5, 1291.
पुरुष- + उत्तम पुरुष- + उत्तम, m. 1. an excellent man, an excellent servant. 2. a name of Viṣṇu. 3. a proper name.
पुरा- + कथा पुरा- + कथा, f. a tale of past ages.
पूर्व- + काय पूर्व- + काय, m. the fore-part of the body, Śāk. d. 7.
पुरुष- + केशरिन् पुरुष- + केशरिन्, m. a name of Viṣṇu in his fourth incarnation (half man, half lion).
पूर्ण- + चन्द्र पूर्ण- + चन्द्र, m. the full of the moon, Rām. 3, 53, 44.
पूर्व- + चित्ति पूर्व- + चित्ति, f. 1. first thought. 2. the name of an Apsaras.

पूर्व- + जन्मन् पूर्व- + जन्मन्,
 I. n. a former existence.
 II. m. an elder brother.
पूर्व- + जाति पूर्व- + जाति, f. a former existence, Kathās. 27, 82.
पूर्ण- + तूण पूर्ण- + तूण, adj. full quivered.
पूर्व- + दक्षिण पूर्व- + दक्षिण, adj. south-eastern, Mārk. P. 58, 19.
पूर्व- + दिश् पूर्व- + दिश्, n. fate, Bhāg. P. 6, 17, 17.
पूर्व- + देव पूर्व- + देव, m. a primeval divinity, MBh. 5, 1921.
पूर्व- + देवता पूर्व- + देवता, f. a primeval divinity, Man. 3, 192.
पूर्व- + देश पूर्व- + देश, m. the eastern country, MBh. 2, 1856.
पूर्व- + देह पूर्व- + देह, m. a former existence, Hariv. 9153.
पुर- + द्विष् पुर- + द्विष्, m. a name of Śiva, Bhāg. P. 4, 6, 8.
पूर्व- + पक्ष पूर्व- + पक्ष, m. 1. the first half of a lunar month, Man. 3, 278. 2. the opponent's proposition, a primā facie assertion. 3. action at law, Yājñ. 2, 17.
पुरस्- + पाक पुरस्- + पाक, adj. of which the fulfilment is imminent on.
पूर्ण- + पात्र पूर्ण- + पात्र, m. and n. 1. a full cup. 2. a measure of 256 handfulls of rice.
पूर्व- + पितामह पूर्व- + पितामह, m. an ancestor, Kathās. 21, 20.

1. पुर् पुर् (probably vb. पॄ), f.
 1. A town, Bhāg. P. 6, 6, 12.
 2. The body, 2, 10, 28.
 --Comp.
† 2. पुर् पुर्, i. 6, Par. To go at the head.
पूर् पूर्, see पॄ.

पुर पुर, i. e. probably पॄ + अ,
 I. n.
 1. A fortified town, Man. 7, 70.
 2. A town, 8, 386.
 3. The town, κατ̕ ἐξοχήν i. e. Pāṭaliputra.
 4. An abode, Bhāg. P. 5, 11, 9.
 5. An upper story.
 6. The body, Bhāg. P. 5, 11, 5.
 7. A kind of Cyperus.
 8. Skin.
 II. m.
 1. A sort of resin, Bdellium.
 2. The name of a demon.
 III. f. रा, A perfume.
 IV. f. री (also रि).
 1. A town, Megh. 31.
 2. The body, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 28.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πόλις, πτόλις, perhaps also πύργος.

पुरा पुरा (old instrum. sing. of a [] base पुर, for पर, cf. पुरस्; उ is changed to अ by the influence of the preceding प्);
 I. adv.
 1. Formerly, Man. 1, 119.
 2. Of old, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1231.
 3. With न, Never, MBh. 9, 1806.
 4. First.
 5. Soon.
 II. prep. with abl., Before, Arj. 4, 20.
 --Cf. πάροι (old loc.) in πάροιθε, παροίτερος, πάλαι (old dat.), παλαιός, etc.; perhaps also πέλας with πλησίος, etc.; Goth. faura and faur; A.S. for, fora-, fore-; Lat. por-, e. g. in por-tendere, and probably also prō-.

पूर पूर् + अ, m.
 1. Filling, Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 7.
 2. A large quantity of water, Ragh. 3, 17.
 3. A cake, Rām. 2, 100, 64 Gorr.
 4. Drawing in breath through the nose, a religious practice, Bhāg. P. 3, 28, 9.
 5. The healing or cleansing of ulcers.
 --Comp.

पुरःसर पुरःसर, i. e. पुरस्-सृ + अ, adj., f. री, and sbst.
 1. One who goes first or before, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 27; a leader, a preceder, MBh. 4, 630; Śāk. d. 77.
 2. When latter part of a comp. adj. the fem. ends in रा, Preceded by, attended with, with; e. g. प्रिय-आख्यान-, adj. Preceded by agreeable news, i. e. with agreeable news, Rām. 1, 10, 31 Gorr.
 3. रम्, adv. Preceded by, with; e. g. प्रणिपात-पुरःसरम्, With a prostration, Mārk. P. 77, 30 (laying herself at his feet); after, Pañc. 16, 4.
पुरग पुरग, i. e. probably पुरस्-ग, adj. Inclined to, Mārk. P. 64, 3.

पुरजित् पुर-जि + त्, m.
 1. A name of Śiva.
 2. A proper name.

पुरंजन पुरंजन, i. e. पुर + म्-जन् + अ,
 I. m. The soul, personified as a king, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 9 sqq.
 II. f. नी, The intellect, personified as his queen.

पुरंजय पुरंजय, i. e. पुर + म्-जि + अ, m. A proper name.
 --Comp.
पुरट पुरट, n. Gold, Bhāg. P. 3, 15, 29.

पुरतस् पुर + तस् (cf. पुरा), adv.
 1. Before, in front (with gen.), Rām. 2, 39, 6.
 2. Forward, Vikr. 65, 7.
पुरंदर पुरंदर, i. e. पुर + म्-दॄ + अ, m. Destroyer of castles, a name of Indra.

पुरंधि पुरंधि,
 I. f. Understanding, wisdom.
 II. adj. Intelligent.
पुरंध्रि and पुरंध्री पुरंध्री̆, i. e. पुर + म्-धृ + ई, and the final shortened, f. A respectable matron, Ragh. 7, 25.
पुरश्चरणता पुरश्चरणता, i. e. पुरस्-चरण + ता, f. Preparation, MBh. 12, 13206.

पुरस् पुर + स् (cf. पुरा),
 I. adv.
 1. Forward.
 2. Before, in front, in presence, Śāk. 29, 1; Pañc. i. d. 135.
 3. First, Śāk. d. 33.
 4. Eastward, from the east, MBh. 7, 2349.
 II. prep. with the gen., Before, Megh. 3.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πάρος, πρόσθε, πρόσθιος, etc., perhaps πρες, in πρέσβυς.

पुरस्कार पुरस्-कार, m.
 1. Preference, Mālav. 19, 6.
 2. Deference, Rām. 1, 80, 11 Gorr.
 3. As latter part of comp. adj. Preceded by, joined with; e. g. सुरा-सव-, adj. Together with spirituous liquors, MBh. 13, 4737.
पुरस्क्रिया पुरस्-क्रिया, f. Deference, Ragh. 4, 87.

पुरस्तात् पुरस्-तात् (तात्, an old abl. of तद्),
 I. adv.
 1. Before, in front, Bhag. 11, 40.
 2. First, preceding, Rām. 2, 80, 5.
 3. Forward, Vikr. 31, 4.
 4. Formerly, MBh. 1, 735.
 5. Eastward, in the east, from the east, Megh. 15.
 II. prep. with gen. and abl. Before, Hit. 8, 15.

पुराण पुराण, i. e. पुरा + न,
 I. adj., f. (णा and) णी.
 1. Primeval, Man. 5, 23.
 2. Old, ancient. Mālav. 4, 2.
 3. Aged, Vikr. d. 9; worn out.
 II. n. A tale of past ages; old history, legends; a sacred work treating for the most part of the creation, the destruction and renovation of worlds, the genealogy of gods, etc. There are eighteen acknowledged Purāṇas.
 III. m. A coin of a certain weight, Man. 8, 136.
 --Comp.

पूरण पूरण, i. e. पूर् + अन,
 I. adj., f. णि, Filling, Hariv. 7441.
 II. n. Act of filling, Ragh. 9, 73; completing, satisfying, Mālav. d. 73.
 2. Drawing (a bow), MBh. 16, 271.
 III. m.
 1. A dyke.
 2. The ocean.
 --Comp.

पुरातन पुरा + तन,
 I. adj., f. नी, Old, ancient, Man. 3, 213.
 II. n. An old tale, Rām. 1, 45, 13.
 --Cf. Lat. (regarding the form) prôtenus.
पुराराति पुराराति, and पुरारि पुरारि, i. e. पुर-अराति and -अरि, m. Names of Śiva.
पुराविद् पुरा-विद्, adj. Knowing the past.
पुरि पुरि, and पुरी पुरी, see पुर.

पुरीतत् पुरीतत्, probably पुर् + इ -तन् + त्, n.
 1. An entrail near the heart.
 2. The entrails in general, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 17.

पुरीष पुरीष (akin to पॄ),
 I. n.
 1. Fæces, excrements, Man. 5, 138.
 2. [] The remains of food (in a pot), Bhāg. P. 5, 9, 12.
 II. f. षी (perhaps f. of पुरीष्य), The name of a religious ceremony, 3, 12, 40.

पुरीषण पुरीषण, i. e. पुरीषय (a denomin. derived from पुरीष with the aff. अय) + अन, n.
 1. Evacuation of excrements.
 2. Fæces.
पुरीषम पुरीषम (akin to पुरीष), m. The black kidney bean.

पुरीष्य पुरीष्य, adj. Epithet of fire.
 --Cf. पुरीष, f.

पुरु पुरु, in the Veda also पूरु, i. e. पॄ + उ
 I. adj., f. पुर्वी.
 1. Much, many.
 2. Exceeding. adv. Very, exceedingly.
 II. also पूरु, m. The name of an old prince, Śāk. 7, 4.
 --Cf. πολύ; Goth. filu; A.S. fela, feala; comparat. πλεῖον; Lat. plus.
पूरु पूरु, पूरुष पूरुष, see पुरु, पुरुष.
पुरुकुत्स पुरु-कुत्स, m. A proper name.
पुरुदंशक पुरु-दंश् + अक, m. A goose.
पुरुदंशस् पुरु-दंश् + अस्, m., nom. sing. शा, A name of Indra.
पुरुधा पुरु + धा, adv. Manifold.

पुरुष पुरुष, and sometimes पूरुष,
 I. m.
 1. A man generally or individually, a male, mankind, Man. 1, 32.
 2. Punishment personified, Man. 7, 17.
 3. An attendant, a functionary, 8, 43.
 4. The first man, Hariv. 51.
 5. The soul, Yājñ. 3, 194.
 6. The universal soul, the supreme Being, Mārk. P. 26, 21; Man. 1, 11.
 7. A principle, Man. 1, 19.
 8. A tree, Rottleria tinctoria.
 9. A proper name.
 II. f. षी, A female, Bhāg. P. 5, 24, 17.
 III. n.(?). A name of the mountain Meru.
 --Comp.[]
पुरुषक पुरुष + क, n. Rearing as a horse, standing like a man on two feet, Śiś. 5, 56.

पुरुषकार पुरुष-कार, m.
 1. Any act of man, care, Man. 8, 232.
 2. The exertion of man (opposite to fate), Yājñ. 1, 348.
 3. A proper name.
पुरुषता पुरुष + ता, f., and पुरुषत्व पुरुष + त्व, n. Manhood, MBh. 13, 552.
पुरुषन्ति पुरुषन्ति, m. A proper [] name, Chr. 298, 23 = Rigv. 1, 112, 23.
पुरुषशीर्षक पुरुष-शीर्ष + क (m. n.?), The name of a thief's instrument, Daśak. 71, 1.
पुरुषादत्व पुरुषादत्व, i. e. पुरुष-आद + त्व, n. State or condition of a man-eater, or demon, MBh. 13, 326.

पुरुषान्तर पुरुषान्तर, i. e. पुरुष-अन्तर,
 I. n. A following generation, Mārk. P. 118, 31.
 II. m.
 1. Man (opposed to deities), Vikr. d. 35.
 2. A treaty by which is stipulated that the affairs of the one shall be settled by warriors selected from both parties, Kām. Nītis. 9, 13.
पुरुषाय पुरुषाय, a denomin. derived from पुरुष with य, Ātm. To behave like a man, MBh. 12, 8102.
पुरूरवस् पुरूरवस्, m. The name of a king.
पुरूवसु पुरूवसु, i. e. पुरु-वसु, adj. Abounding in riches.

पुरोग पुरोग, and पुरोगम पुरोगम, i. e. पुरस्-ग and -गम,
 I. adj.
 1. Going before, preceding, Nal. 4, 20.
 2. Chief, Ragh. 6, 55.
 II. m. A leader, MBh. 3, 2522.
 --Comp.
पुरोजन्मता पुरोजन्मता, i. e. पुरस्-जन्मन् + ता, f. Priority of birth, Ragh. 16, 1.

पुरोडाश पुरोडाश, i. e. पुरस्-दाश् + अ, m.
 1. A kind of cake made of rice meal, offered in oblations to the [] gods, Man. 6, 11.
 2. An oblation to deities, Man. 5, 23.
पुरोडाशीय पुरोडाशीय, i. e. पुरोडाश + ईय, adj., f. या, Relating to the sacrificial cakes.
पुरोध पुरोध = पुरोधस्, MBh. 3, 10635.
पुरोधस् पुरोधस्, i. e. पुरस् and vb. धा, m. The family or domestic priest of a prince, Śāk. 71, 18.
पुरोधिका पुरोधिका (probably पुरस्-धा + इका), f. A favourite wife, Hariv. 7817.
पुरोहित पुरोहित, see धा with पुरस्.

† पुर्व्, पूर्व् पू̆र्व्, and पूर्ब् पूर्ब्, i. 1, Par. To fill (cf. पॄ).
 --i. 10, Par. To dwell.
पूर्व् पूर्व्, see पुर्व्.

पूरक पूर् + अक,
 I. adj.
 1. Filling.
 2. Filling up, Man. 9, 289.
 3. Satisfying, MBh. 1, 75.
 II. m.
 1. Closing the right nostril, and drawing up air through the left, a religious observance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 17.
 2. A citron (Citrus medica).
 3. The final obsequial cake.
 --Comp.
पूरयितृ पूरयितृ, i. e. पूर्, i. 10, + तृ, m., f. त्रि, n. One who fills up, who satisfies.
पूरिक पूरिक, i. e. पूर + इक, m., and f. का, A sort of cake, MBh. 7, 2309.
ऽपूरिन् -पूर् + इन्, adj. Filling, MBh. 8, 4669.

पूर्णक पूर्ण + क (vb. पृ),
 I. adj. Filled, full, MBh. 7, 2199.
 II. m.
 1. A certain tree, Rām. 3, 79, 38.
 2. The blue jay.
 III. f. निका, A sort of bird.
पूर्णता पूर्ण + ता (vb. पॄ), f. Plenty, Megh. 20.
पूर्णत्व पूर्ण + त्व (vb. पॄ). n. Being full of. Kathās. 16, 46.

पूर्णपात्रमय पूर्ण-पात्र + मय (cf. [] पात्र), adj., f. यी.
 1. Consisting in a पूर्ण-पात्र, MBh. 12, 2306.
 2. Concerning full cups. Kathās. 23, 84 (? Brockh., Consisting in a poem).
पूर्णमा पूर्णमा, and पूर्णिमा पूर्णिमा, i. e. पूर्ण and curtailed मास, f. The night or day of full moon, Rājat. 5, 156; Pañc. 74, 22.
पूर्ब् पूर्ब्, see पुर्व्.
पूर्ब पूर्ब, see पूर्व.
पूर्भिद्य पूर्भिद्य, i. e. पुर्-भिद् + य n. The destruction of castles, war, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14.

पूर्व पूर्व, i. e. पुर + व (see पुरा), also पार्ब, adj., f. वा (बा).
 1. Fore, Śāk. d. 37.
 2. Former, prior, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 905.
 3. First, Man. 1, 10.
 4. Lowest, Man. 8, 120.
 5. Eastern, Man. 2, 22.
 II. adv. वम्.
 1. Before, Chr. 3, 2; first, Pañc. 51, 18.
 2. Formerly, Chr. 16, 20.
 3. Immemorially, Man. 9, 87.
 III. पूर्वेण, instr. adv. To the east, Rām. 2, 70, 11.
 IV. An ancestor, Pañc. iii. d. 216; Man. 3, 220.
 V. f. वा, The cast.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. पूर्वेद्युस्.

पूर्व-पूर्व पूर्व-पूर्व,
 I. adj. every preceding one.
 II. m. pl. ancestors, [] MBh. 3, 12408.

पूर्वक पूर्व + क,
 I. adj., f. विका.
 1. Prior, before, preceding, MBh. 12, 13697.
 2. First, Rām. 1, 70, 21.
 3. As latter part of comp. adj. often, Accompanied by, Man. 2, 78.
 II. कम्, adv.
 1. With, Man. 2, 128.
 2. Conformable to, 2, 173.
 III. m. An ancestor, Hariv. 5176.
 --Comp.
पूर्वग पूर्व-ग, adj. Preceding, Rājat. 1, 18.

पूर्वज पूर्व-ज,
 I. adj., f. जा.
 1. Born or produced before, formerly, Man. 9, 31.
 2. Eldest, Bhāg. P. 9, 2, 2.
 II. m.
 1. An elder brother, Man. 2, 226.
 2. pl. Ancestors, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 7.
पूर्वतन पूर्व + तन, adj. Former, older.

पूर्वतस् पूर्व + तस्, adv.
 1. To the east, MBh. 9, 2361.
 2. First, Bhāg. P. 9, 9, 32.
पूर्वत्र पूर्व + त्र = loc. of पूर्व; with जन्मनि, In a former existence, Kathās. 13, 131.
पूर्वदेहिक पूर्वदेहिक, i. e. पूर्व-देह + इक, adj. Done in a former existence, MBh. 12, 12151.
पूर्ववत् पूर्व + वत्, adv. As before, Man. 11, 213.
पूर्वथा पूर्व + था, adv. As before, Chr. 294, 2 = Rigv. i. 92, 2.
पूर्ववर्तिता पूर्ववर्तिता, i. e. पूर्व-वर्तिन् + ता, f. Priority, Bhāṣāp. 15.
पूर्वविद् पूर्व-विद्, adj. Knowing former times, Man. 9, 44.
पूर्वाह्ण पूर्वाह्ण, i. e. पूर्व-अहन् + अ, m. The forenoon, Man. 4, 96.
पूर्वाह्णिक पूर्वाह्णिक, i. e. पूर्वाह्ण + इक, f. की, Belonging to the forenoon, in the forenoon, MBh. 13, 1573.
पूर्विक in स्त्री-, i. e. स्त्री-पूर्व + इक, adj. One who has been at first a female, Chr. 63, 67.

पूर्विन् पूर्विन्, adj., f. इणी, Done by ancestors.
 --Comp.

पूर्वेद्युस् पूर्वेद्युस्, i. e. पूर्व + इ-दिव् + अस्, adv.
 1. A former day, yesterday, Man. 3, 187.
 2. The morning.
 --Cf. प्रातर् and πρώϊ-ζος, πρώϊζα.
पूर्वोत्पन्नत्व पूर्वोत्पन्नत्व, i. e. पूर्व-उद्-पन्न (vb. पद्), + त्व, n. Condition of anterior existence, Bhāṣāp. 122.
पुरःफल पुरःफ्˚, i. e. पुरस्-, adj. of which the fruit is coming on.

पुरोभाग पुरोभाग, i. e. पुरस्-,
 I. m. 1. obtrusiveness, Hariv. 7338. 2. envy, Mālav. d. 19.
 II. adj., f. गा, obtrusive, Śāk. 70, 14.
पुरोभागिन् पुरोभागिन्, i. e. पुरस्- (cf. पुरोभाग under भाग), adj., f. गिणी, 1. obtrusive, Śāk. 70, 14 v. r. 2. envious, censorious, Rājat. 6, 83.
पूर्व- + भाषिन् पूर्व- + भाषिन्, adj. speaking first, making advances, Rām. 2, 1, 7 Gorr.
पुर- + मथन पुर- + मथन, m. the destroyer of Pura, a name of Śiva, Lass. 67, 6.
